description: Source code for managing EGL display connections in Android, including initialization, termination, extension handling, and platform-specific display retrieval.

classes.name: egl_display_t
classes.description: Represents an EGL display connection, manages its state, objects, and extensions.

methods.name: findExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension is present in the extension string.

methods.name: needsAndroidPEglMitigation
methods.description: Determines if Android P vendor partitions require specific EGL extension mitigation.

methods.name: egl_display_t::get
methods.description: Retrieves the egl_display_t instance associated with a given EGLDisplay handle.

methods.name: egl_display_t::getFromNativeDisplay
methods.description: Gets an EGLDisplay from a native display type, possibly using platform-specific logic.

methods.name: egl_display_t::getPlatformDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves a platform-specific EGLDisplay, with special handling for ANGLE and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: egl_display_t::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the EGL display, queries version and extension strings, and sets up extensions.

methods.name: egl_display_t::terminate
methods.description: Terminates the EGL display, releases resources, and cleans up objects.

methods.name: egl_display_t::loseCurrent
methods.description: Releases the current context and surfaces from the display.

methods.name: egl_display_t::loseCurrentImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for losing current context and surfaces.

methods.name: egl_display_t::makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes a context and surfaces current on the display.

methods.name: egl_display_t::haveExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension is supported by the display.
